brief:
US House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries called Thursday for "dramatic change" in the Middle East, according to Al-Monitor, and reiterated support for a two-state solution to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. Jeffries did not specify what changes he envisions or provide details on how the US should pursue such a resolution.

The Democratic leader's remarks reflect ongoing pressure within Congress for a revised approach to the region amid the current conflict.
dek: By Patricia Zengerle WASHINGTON, Nov 12 (Reuters) - US House of Representatives Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries called on Thursday for "dramatic change" in the Middle East and reiterated his support for a two-state solution for Israel and the Palestinians.
title: Jeffries calls for dramatic Middle East policy shift, reiterates two-state backing
